assets.transformations: Original rounded Three.js coach bodies, barrel roofs, windows, bogies, wheels, couplers and brass trim; instanced route pieces and physical 45-coach reserve; geographic atlas with 47 city positions and adaptive labels, 101 curved routes and separated double tracks; original vector wagon-card and locomotive artwork; separate stock tray, physical tickets and clipboard; aspect-aware relative-mouse zones and visible-pointer board zoom/pan; self-hosted IBM Plex typography; no publisher scans, artwork or logos imported; tutorial focus restrictions, explicit turn confirmation and frame-time-aware camera transitions; four original short cartoon railway characters inspired by the selected Fisherman form reference; continuous anatomical five-finger hands with independent 22-bone skeletons, normalized skin weights, mirrored deformation, quaternion animation clips and card-following foreground grips; closed sculpted heads integrating cheeks, chin, nose, eye sockets, eyelids and lips; palmward independent MCP/PIP/DIP hinges, thumb CMC/MCP/IP contact pose, finite asymmetric joint skinning bands, shared metacarpal web weights preserving interphalangeal influence, continuous dorsal joint support and edge-pinching card pose
assets.hashKind: sha256 of ordered file name + LF + file bytes + LF for each source
